title: Base image choice: footprint, cold build time and cold start
hypothesis: For an identical pure-Python Flask workload, slim, Alpine and distroless bases reduce image size by more than 70% relative to the full Debian image, and reduce cold-start latency measurably; Alpine's musl libc does not change cold start for a pure-Python app.
notes: Cold build uses --no-cache but base layers may already be present locally after warm-up; this is intentional and mirrors a developer machine. Set design.prune_between_trials=true for a fully cold builder cache.
